about: [C7] proof (WAVE_C §7) of the quiet pass: the player who does nothing loses, warned first. (1) Hands off in the dark by the side door: the first man's round brings his lantern down the aisle to the door - the shout ('They've seen me.'), he runs at me, the cosh, 'They caught you.', back at the door. (2) Then stood in the door's pool of light: caught within seconds, warned first. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/pier_idle.json

steps.eval: (window.W = () => G.scenes.ctx.flags.live, window.T0 = G.time, window.WARN = [], G.on('fail', (e) => WARN.push({ why: e.why, warned: G.lastFail && G.lastFail.warnedFor, t: +(G.time - T0).toFixed(1) })), 1)

steps.name: (1) hands off, standing in the dark by the door

steps.label: found in the dark by the round's lantern: warned a second or more, then caught

steps.name: (2) into the door's pool of light, and stand there

steps.expect: G.lastFail.why === 'They caught you.' && G.lastFail.warnedFor >= 1.0 && G.time - T1 < 20
steps.label: stood in the pool: caught within seconds, warned first
